Independent direct enumeration of all 2^21 masks and BFS of three 7!-orbits
Kolesnik et al arXiv:2312.04532 full primary text
correctness.rationale: I independently enumerated all 2^21 labeled tournaments by exact oriented-edge masks, filtered by outdegree three, obtaining 2640. Exactly 14 cyclic triangles are flippable at each state (hence 18480 undirected edges). Explicit orbit generation under the 7! label permutations gave orbit sizes 240,720,1680, covering all 2640 states. Exact BFS from each orbit representative visited the entire graph and reproduced shell profiles: 240:(1,14,91,343,749,871,476,92,3), 720:(1,14,91,336,721,822,485,147,22,1), 1680:(1,14,91,340,739,853,483,113,6). Converse distances were 7,9,7; the sole radius-nine shell in the 720 orbit is its converse, yielding 720/2=360 antipodal unordered pairs, global diameter nine and radius eight. Independent four-subset enumeration recovered cyclic-triangle histograms (0,14,21),(7,0,28),(3,8,24), identifying the middle orbit by absence of one-cyclic-triangle four-sets. The source code checks every state; this is a genuinely complete finite proof, not sampling.
